name: Hold Until Rotation
description: Survive 84 Earth days and hand over an operational research station.

name: First Command
description: A well-stocked station and an early relief window. A good first command.

name: Highland Watch
description: A worn solar array and limited water. Pack for ten weeks of careful maintenance.

name: Extended Survey
description: A long research watch with aging life support. Two crew must make the handover.

name: Power on the Edge
description: Weak solar output strains power reserves. Endure sixteen weeks with two survivors.

name: The Long Watch
description: The longest rotation, damaged systems, and little stored power. Keep two crew alive.
